metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting a fly and somehow convinced 1 poor soul to uninstall? Valorant logic!
metadata.description:
Tapping like I had zero clue and still snagged a kill
Enemy probably rethinking life choices
Did NOT deserve that but I’ll take the chaos
If your aim’s mostly accidental, welcome to the club

Tap if your aim’s a beautiful disaster too!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
